scope: Independent headless Edge browser-process trees with synthetic API responses. Same shared Windows workload; excludes Java/native backend CPU and process memory. Hidden visibility is emulated; browser throttling is not.
samplingLimit: CPU between the last sample and a process exit may be missed. New process CPU starts at zero. Inspect raw process IDs for churn.
workload: Build, startup and package validation completed before capture. Root agent ran no builds or service activity during capture; other shared Windows development workload remains uncontrolled.
